name: com.unitymvc.core
description:
Lightweight Unity MVC backbone: views auto-wire controllers/models via attributes and expose DI plus an event bus with lifetime-aware cancellation—minimal boilerplate for UI and gameplay logic.

Recommendation: install together with VContainer to access all features; see https://vcontainer.hadashikick.jp/getting-started/installation

samples.description: Example usage of UnityMVC in several scenarios.
